title: Facile access to quinazolin-4(3H)-ones by tandem Cu-catalyzed annulation of 2-nitrobenzonitrile and alcohols under air
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25965-25970
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01550B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuan Lam Vu, Ban Van Phuc, Minh Hoang Nguyen, Thuy Anh T. Nguyen, Thuy Linh Nguyen, Hien Nguyen, Quoc Anh Ngo, Nguyen Quang An, Tran Quang Hung, Tuan Thanh Dang
A convenient Cu-catalyzed synthesis of 2-arylquinazolin-4(3H)-one derivatives has been developed using simple starting materials such as 2-nitrobenzonitriles and alcohols under mild conditions.
